retry_exception_classes: URLError only with an allowlisted underlying transport exception
OSError only errno ECONNRESET, ECONNABORTED, ECONNREFUSED, EPIPE, ETIMEDOUT, ENETUNREACH, EHOSTUNREACH
retry_envelope: malformed provider envelope or completed response without recoverable claims/questions experiment envelope
history: create-once attempt records/raw response; no overwrite, no best-of; unknown delivery consumes one attempt
pacing: max(60 seconds, provider Retry-After) between request starts; reset/timeout unknown delivery retains history; no automatic recovery after three attempts
rate_limit: Account last observed at 30000 TPM. Single-flight; record input/schema estimate and output reservation separately. Local estimate is not provider TPM accounting. Before live authorization confirm account headroom; honor response Retry-After; three-attempt bound, no new recovery without approval.
acceptance: output-cap incomplete stops capacity acceptance; never increase output cap automatically
